snippet.title: The last keeper indie Game
snippet.description:
I’m Mario from a small indie team. We’re making The Last Keeper — a slow-burn psychological horror inspired by the 1900 Flannan Isles lighthouse mystery.


You play as a former captain who lost his son and crew because of a lighthouse keeper’s mistake. He voluntarily takes the job at the same lighthouse — as punishment and redemption.
But the island isn’t empty. Something here feeds on guilt, and the harder you try to stay sane and do your duty, the more reality starts to slip.

What to expect:

-Lighthouse work routine: maintenance, isolation, pressure

-Slow, oppressive tension (no cheap jumpscares)

-Vibes inspired by The Lighthouse, and games like Voice of the Void

-Some overlap in mood with Static Dread, but with a stronger focus on the keeper’s “work” structure

Would love feedback: does the routine + atmosphere feel engaging, or too slow?
